film_title: Return of The Tall Blond Man

alterations.description: Reduce mock fights to tone down tension, deleting hard hitting shots, machine gun firings, fake blood, brick throwing, and blood from wounds.
Reduce the view of the policeman being kicked and running about holding his middle.
Reduce the bed scene showing Francois and Maurice's wife in bed and her search for earrings under the bed cover.
Delete close view of the dress parted at the back revealing the lady's bare back.
Delete Roomal's double meaning dialogue when he prepares for yatra.
Reduce the 'Suhaag raat' scene of Arun and Usha by deleting prolonged instructions pertaining to physical proximity.
Delete Lily's dialogue about 'Gupt Gyan Ka Doosra path' when she pulls Anand inside the room.
Delete the underlined word from Anthony's dialogue addressed to the hotel receptionist.
Delete words and visuals pertaining to song lines about being drunk and vulgar dance gestures.
Reduce considerably the fight between two women in the drinking den.
Delete the word 'dabaana' from dialogues when Ranjit is preparing for his 'Suhaag Raat'.
Reduce the scene where the camera cuts back and forth from Ranjit's face to Nirmala's breasts, deleting the portion where Ranjit imagines she is lowering the zip of her blouse.
Delete or modify the last scenes showing Ranjit with his new female secretary to remove the impression of an ongoing affair.
Delete reference to Americans refusing to sell steel to Russia in the 2nd World War.
From the visuals of the song, delete shots showing frequent kissing, retaining only one innocuous shot.
Delete underlined words spoken by Rajkumar to Toni relating to love and marriage.
Delete underlined words spoken by Dewan relating to marriage and spending a night together.
